system.description: You claim a particular area as your hunting ground and tolerate no trespassers, especially other predators such as vampires and Lupines. If you catch another vampire entering your turf uninvited, you must make a Self-Control/Instinct Virtue Test as if provoked or fly into a frenzy and attack. You also dislike leaving your home for long; roleplay this reticence.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
